uncertain_sources.resolution: Garbled operator wording was normalized to the standard ket and dual-bra evolution laws stated by the surrounding speech.
The unit-dependent numerical aside was retained only as the secure point that human-scale units make hbar appear small.
The difference quotient was regularized from an origin-at-zero expression to an arbitrary time origin.
Live sign errors were replaced by the corrected exponential, cosine, and sine relation accepted in the room.
The garbled operator exponential was reconstructed from the explicitly diagonal energy-basis matrix.
The lecture's magnetic-moment normalization and sign were retained as a convention rather than presented as a universal electron convention.
The corrected sine-cosine ordering was used with an arbitrary initial phase.
The spoken phrase three energy levels was corrected to two distinct levels, one threefold-degenerate triplet and one singlet.
Energy ordering was made explicitly dependent on the sign of the unspecified coupling.
Noisy final algebra was checked by factoring the mean energy and energy splitting from the two exact exponential amplitudes.
